data.value: The system denied access to the save folder. Check that the folder isn't read-only or protected (for example by antivirus or cloud sync) and try again.

data.name: Error_BackupExists
data.value: A backup with this same time already exists, and the app never overwrites backups. Wait a second and try again.

data.name: Error_BackupFailed
data.value: The backup couldn't be created, so the app didn't write. Check the free space and permissions of the save folder and try again.

data.name: Error_Conflict
data.value: This change edits something another pending change already edited. Open the review, discard one of the two and redo the edit.

data.name: Error_GameRunning
data.value: The game is running, and it would overwrite the save when it saves or exits. Close the game and try again.

data.name: Error_InvalidEdit
data.value: This change isn't valid for this save. Discard it, adjust your choice and try again.

data.name: Error_NoSession
data.value: No save is open. Choose a profile and a save to get started.

data.name: Error_NothingToApply
data.value: There are no changes to write. Make an edit in a module and come back to review.

data.name: Error_NothingWritten
data.value: Nothing was written. Your save is as it was.

data.name: Error_PendingKept
data.value: Your pending changes are still here.

data.name: Error_ReadOnlySession
data.value: This save is open for viewing only, so it can't be written. Open the save again from the save picker.

data.name: Error_SaveChangedOnDisk
data.value: The save file changed after you opened it (for example, the game saved). To avoid losing progress, the app didn't write. Open the save again and redo your changes.

data.name: Error_SaveCorrupt
data.value: The save file looks damaged and couldn't be read. Pick another save or restore a backup (game.sii.bak-…).

data.name: Error_SaveNotFound
data.value: We couldn't find the save file. It may have been moved, renamed or deleted. Go back to the save list and pick another one.

data.name: Error_SaveParseFailed
data.value: Couldn't understand this save: its content wasn't recognized. It may come from a newer game version, an unusual mod or a damaged file. Try another save from the same profile or, if it keeps happening, report the problem.

data.name: Error_SessionBusy
data.value: The save is still being read or written. Wait a few seconds and try again.

data.name: Error_SlotUnavailable
data.value: Couldn't create a new save: the profile has no free slot or the folder couldn't be created. Go back to the review and write with “Overwrite this save”, or delete an old save in the game.

data.name: Error_StalePatch
data.value: The data behind this change is out of date. Go back to the review, discard the change and redo the edit. If it keeps happening, open the save again.

data.name: Error_UnknownAttribute
data.value: This save doesn't have the field the app tried to change. This usually happens with saves from mods or another game version. Discard the change, try another item or update the app.

data.name: Error_UnknownUnit
data.value: We couldn't find the item you wanted to change in the save. It may have been removed. Go back to the review, discard the change and pick the item again.

data.name: Error_VerifyFailed
data.value: The written file didn't pass verification, so the original save was kept. Try again; if it repeats, open the save again and redo your changes.

data.name: Error_WriteFailed
data.value: The file couldn't be written. Check whether another program (such as antivirus or cloud backup) is using the save folder and try again.
